note: Provincial recreation site campground about 34 km north of Paradise Hill on Highway 21, set in pine woods behind a sandy beach about a kilometre long, with a boat launch and an enclosed fish-cleaning station (closed after the September long weekend). A precautionary drinking-water advisory for the Bronson Forest site was reported in June 2026: check before drinking the tap water. --Claude
